consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: 10 Litres of Davco® Grey One Pot adhesive cover approximately 7.5m2 (based on a 6mm notched trowel)

open_time.label: Adjustability Time
open_time.text: 15-25 minutes dependant on tile and substrate porosity.

cure_times.label: Applied Product Ready for Use
cure_times.text: Allow 24 hours drying before returning to dry area service.

cure_times.label: Applied Product Ready for Use
cure_times.text: Allow a minimum 7 days drying before returning to wet area service

compat.text: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is suitable for common board substrates such as fibre cement sheet, plasterboard, and ceramic tile underlay.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive can also be used with rendered brickwork and blockwork.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is designed for use for domestic residential applications on wall and porous floor substrates including kitchens, bathrooms and laundries.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is suitable for use on internal applications only.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is not suitable for tiling over concrete, waterproofing membranes or existing ceramic tiles
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Suitable for internal walls and floors
compat.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

compat.text: Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is suitable for adhering porous (>3% absorption) tiles over Davco Waterproofing Membranes for walls only

sds.title: SDS Davco Grey One Pot adhesive

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Materials to avoid
storage.text: No special restrictions on storage with other products.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. No special handling advice required. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
